definitions.explanation: The legal right of a foreign national to reside in a country. In Japan, this is governed by immigration law and tied to specific visa categories.

examples.japanese: {在留権|ざいりゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧。
{在留権|ざいりゅうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: I completed the procedure to renew my residency right.

examples.japanese: ⟦{永住|えいじゅう}→永住：15124_eijuu⟧{在留権|ざいりゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{外国人|がいこくじん}→外国人：02869_gaikokujin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: Foreign nationals with permanent residency rights can work freely in Japan.

notes:
Combines ⟦{在留|ざいりゅう}→在留：12128_zairyuu⟧ (residing, staying) and {権|けん} (right). Particularly relevant for foreign nationals living in Japan, as residency status is closely tied to visa categories and determines what activities a person can engage in.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {在留権|ざいりゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取得|しゅとく}する→取得する：10444_shutokusuru⟧: to obtain residency rights
- {在留権|ざいりゅうけん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧: to lose residency rights
- ⟦{永住|えいじゅう}→永住：15124_eijuu⟧{在留権|ざいりゅうけん}: permanent residency right
- {在留権|ざいりゅうけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}→更新：04765_koushin⟧: renewal of residency right
